newsitem.title: ALGERIA: Port conditions update - Algeria - Lloyds Shipping.
newsitem.headline: Port conditions update - Algeria - Lloyds Shipping.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --
ALGERIA, May 10 - Algiers - Around 20 vessels, most with bagged potatoes and sugar are in Algiers roads awaiting entrance.
Due to this congestion the port authorities decided to take severe measures to ease congestion and reduce waiting time.
All sampling and quality control to be carried out while vessels are on roads with no berthing allowed before.
The first measure if a vessel is berthed for three days without discharge is that she will be immediately shifted at anchorage at her own charges.
Vessels have to be equipped with proper cranes/derricks otherwise they will be rerouted to another port.
Cargoes are to be pre-slung or palletised to reduce time of discharge and discharge is to be carried out with maxi gangs on four shifts a day.
